171: func _new_tween(target: Node) -> Tween:
172: 	if not _is_valid(target):
173: 		return null
174: 	return target.create_tween().set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)

193: func fade(node: CanvasItem, from: float, to: float, dur: float = 0.4) -> PropertyTweener:
194: 	if not _is_valid(node):
195: 		return null
196: 	# No forced modulate – start tween from whatever alpha the node already has
197: 	return _new_tween(node).tween_property(node, "modulate:a", to, dur)

202: func show_canvas(node: CanvasItem, dur: float = 0.3) -> PropertyTweener:
203: 	return fade(node, node.modulate.a, 1.0, dur)

1165: func button_hover(btn: Control, scale_factor: float = 1.1, dur: float = 0.12) -> Tween:
1166: 	if not _is_valid(btn):
1167: 		return null
1168: 	var t = _new_tween(btn)
1169: 	t.tween_property(btn, "scale", Vector2.ONE * scale_factor, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
1170: 	return t

1173: func button_unhover(btn: Control, dur: float = 0.1) -> PropertyTweener:
1174: 	if not _is_valid(btn):
1175: 		return null
1176: 	return _new_tween(btn).tween_property(btn, "scale", Vector2.ONE, dur)

1179: func button_press(btn: Control, dur: float = 0.08) -> Tween:
1180: 	if not _is_valid(btn):
1181: 		return null
1182: 	var t = _new_tween(btn)
1183: 	t.tween_property(btn, "scale", Vector2.ONE * 0.9, dur)
1184: 	t.tween_property(btn, "scale", Vector2.ONE, dur)
1185: 	return t
